paragraphs: Civica makes software that public bodies use to deliver critical services to citizens around the world. It says over 6,000 public bodies use that software to help provide critical services to over 100 million citizens.

Its solutions span local and central government, health and community care, housing and social care, libraries and education, and regulatory and compliance services. The company describes integrated cloud platforms that automate workflows, support data-driven decision-making and reduce operational costs. Named products include Spydus, a library management system. Civica also sells master data management for state and local government. It says it is an approved supplier on major government frameworks.

Civica was established in 2001 and describes itself as one of the UK's largest software companies. Its team has grown to 5,500 colleagues, one-third of whom have worked in the sectors it serves. Acquisitions are part of the strategy, with more than 37 completed in the last 10 years. The company reports delivery in the UK, Australia, New Zealand, India, North America and Europe. Customer stories on its site include delivering a single citizen view for the State of Alaska.

quote.text: We make software to serve citizens around the world.
